HCD-ANAL.description: HC Design Analysis Element Selection (HCD-ANAL). Selects which elements the HC design analysis runs on; the element set is resolved from the first assigned field in priority order KEYS, then TO, then STRUCTURE_GROUP_NAME.

Argument.description: Element selection for the HC design analysis (DTO_DESIGN_ANAL_ELEM_SELECTION). All fields are optional; the first assigned field among KEYS, TO, STRUCTURE_GROUP_NAME (in that order) determines the element set.

KEYS.description: Specify Each ID - Element No. Explicit list of element numbers. Highest priority selection source.

TO.description: Specify ID Range - Element Range (e.g. 1-10). Used when KEYS is not provided.

STRUCTURE_GROUP_NAME.description: Structure Group Name. Elements are collected from this structure group. Used when neither KEYS nor TO is provided.
